in_sanskrit.name: निकुञ्ज

in_marathi.name: Nikunj
in_marathi.meaning: हिंदू नाव म्हणजे Young One, Delight, Joy
in_marathi.long_meaning: Nikunj हे एक हिंदू नाव आहे जे भारतीय संस्कृतीत खोल आध्यात्मिक महत्त्व ठेवते। Nikunj is a Sanskrit name derived from the word ‘Nikunj’ which means ‘young one’ or a ‘delightful place’. This name is often associated with Lord Krishna, who is known to have spent his childhood in a grove, a Nikunj. It represents joy, happiness, and the innocence of childhood.
